blocks.orig: Choosing to travel with Your Tanzania Trip means choosing to travel responsibly, sustainably and safely in Tanzania. As a company, we care deeply about contributing to Tanzania’s social and economic development and we participate in several initiatives to do just that.
blocks.html: When you travel with Your Tanzania Trip, you are choosing a responsible, sustainable and safe way to see Tanzania. Contributing to the country's social and economic development matters a great deal to us as a company, and we take part in a number of initiatives that do exactly that.

blocks.orig: As a trusted travel company in Tanzania providing exceptional wildlife and nature experiences, we understand that the great wilds of Tanzania need protecting and preserving. That’s why we’re dedicated to sustainable business practices and actively contributing to environmental projects throughout the country.
blocks.html: Because we are a trusted Tanzanian travel company offering exceptional encounters with wildlife and nature, we know how much Tanzania's great wild places need to be protected and preserved. For that reason we are committed to running our business sustainably and to playing an active part in environmental projects across the country.

blocks.orig: We choose our luxury lodges and Tanzania accommodation partners based on a list of exacting environmental criteria. One of the most essential points on that list is sustainable business practices. From waste reduction to green energy consumption. 75% of Your Tanzania Trip accommodation options use solar panels.
blocks.html: We select our luxury lodges and other Tanzanian accommodation partners against a strict environmental checklist. High on that checklist is how sustainably they operate, from cutting waste to running on green energy. Solar panels power 75% of the places to stay that Your Tanzania Trip offers.

blocks.orig: Our custom-made Tanzania vacations prioritise eco-friendly experiences. From hiking and biking to canoeing and camping, many of our guests’ favourite activities leave only real footprints.
blocks.html: Low-impact experiences are at the heart of the tailor-made Tanzania vacations we put together. Whether it is hiking, biking, canoeing or camping, a lot of what our guests love most leaves nothing behind but actual footprints.

blocks.orig: In addition to promoting sustainable travel within our guests’ trips, we also try to reduce our carbon footprint by planting trees in our Manyara Tree Planting Project. We proudly launched this project in 2020 on a 30-acre piece of land in the Manyara region. Since then, we added 18 acres close to Arusha National Park, which allowed us to plant thousands of indigenous trees up to now.
blocks.html: Alongside building sustainable choices into our guests' trips, we work to shrink our own carbon footprint through the Manyara Tree Planting Project. We were proud to start it in 2020 on a 30-acre plot in the Manyara region, and have since added a further 18 acres close to Arusha National Park. So far that has allowed us to put thousands of indigenous trees in the ground.

blocks.html: Youth unemployment is a serious problem in Tanzania, with many children and young adults unable to go to school or get an education. A large number of kids also end up living on the streets of the country's big cities. At Your Tanzania Trip this is a cause close to our hearts, and we are determined to do our part. In 2022 we founded the Hakuna Matata Academy, with the goal of giving vulnerable young people a chance while also raising the standard of hospitality in Tanzania. It got off to a good start with six trainers and a range of courses, and today:

blocks.orig: We train 200 street children every year in strengthening their life skills, aiming to eventually offer them a training to work in the hospitality industry.
blocks.html: Each year 200 street children take part in our life-skills programme, the long-term goal being to prepare them for work in hospitality.

blocks.orig: We organise hospitality training for staff of hotels we have on offer, to help develop the quality of Tanzania’s tourism industry.
blocks.html: We arrange hospitality courses for the teams at the hotels we work with, helping to raise standards across Tanzanian tourism.

blocks.orig: We train guides about wildlife and the importance of offering professional service to clients.
blocks.html: We teach guides about wildlife and about why professional service to clients matters.

blocks.orig: The crew follows Leave No Trace principles to keep the impact of trekking on Kilimanjaro's ecosystem as small as possible, and about 5% of each trip funds schooling in a village near the mountain. Choosing Your Tanzania Trip means choosing a crew that is looked after, on a mountain that is looked after.
blocks.html: On Kilimanjaro the crew works to Leave No Trace principles so that trekking disturbs the mountain's ecosystem as little as possible, and roughly 5% of every trip goes towards schooling in a village close to the mountain. Travelling with Your Tanzania Trip means travelling with a crew that is well cared for, on a mountain that is well cared for.

blocks.orig: At Your Tanzania Trip, we are committed to promoting sustainable tourism practices that contribute to environmental conservation, support local communities, and ensure the economic well-being of destinations we operate in. We recognize our responsibility to minimize the negative impacts of tourism and maximize its positive contributions.
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip is dedicated to sustainable tourism: practices that help conserve the environment, support local communities and secure the economic well-being of the places we work in. We know we have a duty to keep the downsides of tourism to a minimum and to make its positive effects as large as possible.
